title: Defend: fips_provider_count as atomic outside the spinlock
description: crypto2dev_registry.c — fips_provider_count is an atomic_t that is inc/decremented under the write_lock but read via atomic_read() in fips_provider_loaded() and lookup_algo() without taking any lock. A reviewer might suggest 'just read the value under the read_lock to avoid atomics'. The existing approach is correct and superior: atomic_read is cheaper than read_lock/read_unlock, callers in the hot path (every ioctl_init) benefit, and the correctness guarantee is identical — the write_lock is already preventing races on the counter during register/unregister. Using the atomic for reads avoids any lock ordering concern between provider_lock and any future per-session locks. Do not change this.
close_reason: Code verified correct. Rationale comments present in source.
